name: Triple Christmas Gold
review:
A festive version of Triple Royal Gold: three reels, up to 27 ways, wilds, avalanches, and free spins with retriggers and a bet multiplier that keeps rising.

It's a small grid with very high volatility, so a lot of spins end with nothing. The 5,000x cap comes from the climbing multiplier in the bonus. The RTP depends on the version the casino runs, topping out at 96.42%, so check the game's info screen before playing for real.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
